2 AM “Healthy” Buldak Dumpling Ramen 🍝😆 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 2 slices Baby Swiss cheese 1 slice American cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tbsp chili oil 1 Buldak sauce packet 1 Buldak seasoning packet 1 tbsp chopped green onions ¾–1 cup heavy cream 4–6 dumplings, cooked 6 cocktail sausages, cooked and scored Extra green onions, chili oil, and sesame seeds for garnish Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles for about half of the recommended cooking time, then drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the Baby Swiss cheese, American cheese, ketchup, mayonnaise, chili oil, Buldak sauce packet, Buldak seasoning packet, and chopped green onions. Stir everything together until the cheese melts and the mixture is smooth. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until creamy and well combined. Add the partially cooked noodles and toss to coat. Let them finish cooking in the sauce for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and creamy. Top with the cooked dumplings and scored sausages. Drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the baby Swiss, American, and Monterey Jack cheese slices. Add the mayo, Buldak sauce, Buldak powder, chili oil, minced garlic, and green onions on top of the cheese. Mix everything together until the cheese melts into a thick spicy paste. Pour in the heavy cream or milk and stir until smooth and creamy. Add the cooked noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. “Dog lovers” vs dog lovers when it comes to greeting dogs! ETA: “dog lovers” could also be replaced with “uniformed, uneducated, and/or inconsiderate dog lovers” vs “informed, educated, and considerate dog lovers” if that makes you more comfortable 🫶 One of my biggest pet peeves is people baby talking to my dog and pretending like I’m interrupting? Bizarre! And in case you didn’t know because it’s something that’s been so normalized, putting your hands in dogs’ faces is unsafe. Dogs don’t need to sniff you up close like that and it’s putting unneeded pressure on them (often leading to bites). The best way to greet a dog is calm, neutral, and honestly just ignoring them. If you want to say hi to a dog, ask the owner first. Try to make yourself small by turning to the side and crouching. Allow the dog to approach you first. Some dogs are super friendly and love people! This doesn’t mean it’s ok to pet or approach without asking their handler! The safest way to greet any dog is by admiring from afar. Admittedly, if I know someone’s dog well, I might be a bit of the former “dog lover” and be excitedly greeting them 😂 It’s different when you know the dog!
